name: @elizaos/plugin-workflow
description: Reviewed workflows: authoring, admission, approvals, scheduling, execution and hosted digests.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vibelang -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const crypto=require('node:crypto');const executable='src/worker/main.js';fs.chmodSync('dist/'+executable,0o755);const sha256=crypto.createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync('dist/'+executable)).digest('hex');fs.writeFileSync('dist/workflow-worker.json',JSON.stringify({executable,sha256})+'\n');"
